description: Defines the OA_Dashboard_Widget_Graph class for rendering graph widgets in the Revive Adserver dashboard, including methods for setting data, rendering graphs with Image_Graph, and formatting values.

classes.name: OA_Dashboard_Widget_Graph
classes.description: A PHP class for rendering graph widgets in the Revive Adserver dashboard, supporting data setting, graph rendering, and value formatting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the widget, setting up translation, cache, and template.

methods.name: getCacheId
methods.description: Returns cache identifier based on hostname, class, and language.

methods.name: isDataRequired
methods.description: Determines if data needs to be fetched based on cache status.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets the graph data for impressions and clicks, translating day labels.

methods.name: setDummyData
methods.description: Initializes dummy data with zero values for the past 7 days.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the graph or image source for the widget, generating a PNG graph if draw is enabled.

methods.name: _formatY
methods.description: Formats numerical values into human-readable strings with units (k, M, B).
